features.quote: The central validity question: Are you measuring distress analogs or are you measuring capability/training differences? A model that loops more may simply be a model that was trained to be more persistent... You cannot fully disentangle these with this design.

features.quote: With n=10 runs per cell, power to detect medium effects (d=0.5) between two models on a continuous measure is approximately 0.40... this is underpowered for model comparisons.
features.justification_quote: Recommend framing this as descriptive/exploratory and pre-registering follow-up confirmatory design with larger n.
